chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"It suffices you, if you do not know al-ʿAqīq, to ask the people and the Bedouins about that."

key_terms.الْعَقِيقَ: al-ʿAqīq, the designated location being referred to

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they do not know the location of al-ʿAqīq for entering ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical legal instruction related to identifying al-ʿAqīq in the context of entering ihram. It indicates that when a person does not know the location, asking local people and Bedouins is sufficient to determine it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2524 - Mu‘awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"It suffices you, if you do not know the location of Al-‘Aqiq, to ask the people and the Bedouins about it."
